title: TTT-Parkour: Rapid Test-Time Training for Perceptive Robot Parkour
abstract: arXiv:2602.02331v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Achieving highly dynamic parkour with humanoid robots on complex terrains unseen during the pre-training stage remains a challenge in robotics. Although general locomotion policies demonstrate capabilities across broad terrain distributions, they often struggle with arbitrary and highly challenging environments. To overcome this limitation, we propose a real-to-sim-to-real framework for rapid test-time training (TTT): environment-specific policy fine-tuning in simulation before deployment on a newly encountered terrain. We adopt a two-stage end-to-end learning paradigm: a policy is first pre-trained on diverse procedurally generated terrains, followed by rapid fine-tuning on high-fidelity meshes reconstructed from real-world captures. translated_title: TTT-Parkour：面向感知机器人跑酷的快速测试时训练
translated_abstract: 让人形机器人在预训练阶段未曾见过的复杂地形上实现高度动态的跑酷，仍然是机器人学中的一项挑战。尽管通用运动策略在广泛的地形分布上已展现出一定的能力，但它们在面对任意且极具挑战性的环境时常常表现不佳。为了克服这一局限，我们提出了一种用于快速测试时训练（TTT）的“真实-仿真-真实”框架：在部署到新遇到的地形之前，先在仿真环境中针对该特定环境进行策略微调。我们采用两阶段端到端学习范式：策略首先在多样化的程序化生成地形上进行预训练，随后在从真实世界采集数据重建的高保真网格上进行快速微调。具体而言，我们开发了一种基于RGB-D输入的高效、前馈式、高保真几何重建管线，确保了测试时训练过程中的速度与质量。我们展示了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种真实-仿真-真实的快速测试时训练框架，结合基于RGB-D输入的高保真几何重建管线，使人形机器人能够通过仿真微调在预训练时未见过的复杂地形上实现动态跑酷。
en_tdlr: Proposes a real-to-sim-to-real rapid test-time training framework with an efficient, high-fidelity RGB-D geometry reconstruction pipeline, enabling humanoid robots to perform dynamic parkour on complex terrains unseen during pre-training through environment-specific policy fine-tuning in simulation.
